  "markdown": "### 3.1 Primary Objective

The primary objective is to evaluate whether the addition of Drug X 350 mg IV Q3W to nivolumab improves the objective response rate (ORR) compared with nivolumab alone in adults with unresectable or metastatic melanoma progressing on anti-PD-1 therapy.

The primary estimand is the difference in ORR (complete response + partial response) between the Drug X plus nivolumab arm and the nivolumab alone arm, as assessed by [TBD: response criteria, e.g., RECIST 1.1] at [TBD: timepoint, e.g., 24 weeks] from randomization. The target population is adults with unresectable or metastatic melanoma progressing on anti-PD-1 therapy. The intercurrent event of treatment discontinuation due to toxicity or disease progression will be handled using the treatment policy strategy (i.e., data collected regardless of discontinuation). The summary measure is the difference in proportions.

### 3.2 Secondary Objectives

Secondary objectives include:
- To evaluate the safety and tolerability of Drug X plus nivolumab compared with nivolumab alone, as measured by the incidence of adverse events (NCT06739226).
- To evaluate progression-free survival (PFS) of Drug X plus nivolumab compared with nivolumab alone (NCT04091750).
- To evaluate overall survival (OS) of Drug X plus nivolumab compared with nivolumab alone [TBD: if not specified in the design brief, confirm as a secondary objective].
